captions.text: Venue managers send shift requests. Open Offers, then Venue Offers.
Requests pending approval need your review.
Open the request that is pending approval.
The venue manager picked two staff. Two places are still open.
Select staff to fill the open places.
Select Confirm to save the selection.
All places are filled. Select Approve to send offers to the selected staff.
The live pipeline opens, with the new offers in the Offered column.
